notes.title: Update 1.2 More levels!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I am happy to announce that we have released another update. This time we have created 7 more new levels! A few minor bugs with sound and textures have also been fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38527774/5bf6f9f503cd95e450b45c20401bdebece4ea631.jpg

Thank you for being with us! 
Have a nice game!

notes.title: First update | Leaderboard | New UI | New levels
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38527774/e8837422fa0cb41ed54d3e167281a1c51c5f1932.jpg
Hello everybody! With great pleasure, I want to present to you a new update!

List of changes:
1. Completely redesigned game interface
2. Extended volume settings
3. Added a leaderboard (by the number of coins collected)
4. Added 2 new levels
5. Some changes have been made at level 6
6. Fake portals no longer carry the player to the beginning of the level, they only send a little back
7. The achievement "The king v. 10" is no longer available due to the release of this update

Still working on the game! You are waiting for new levels and most likely translation into several languages!

I also want to thank those who took their gameplay videos.
Below I will leave links to YouTube videos:

notes.title: Release day!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38527774/7555d73654bfb53dad8ed07eb7bf569e0a85e471.jpg
Here is the day of release!
I am very happy to present you with version 1.0 on this development does not stop and I will once again please you with new updates with interesting levels and new features.

Some news from the patches made today, after the release:
1. Was fixed some places in the 4 and 5 levels, where the player would just get stuck
2. One of the platforms on level 4 became lower, many players could not jump on it
3. the ring maze at level 5 has been made easier, and support points have been added for the player
4. fixed a bug with the premature opening of levels after completing 2-3 levels
5. Fixed bugs with some achievements results
6. Fixed saving graphics settings

 If you encounter any problem, just email me and I will fix it! 
storkyproduction@gmail.com
